intro: A sample of recent work across Luzerne County — weekly maintenance, planting beds, hardscaping and winter snow contracts.

projects.title: Weekly lawn maintenance
projects.alt: A large striped back lawn freshly mowed, with a crew member trimming near the treeline
projects.description: Weekly mow, trim and blow-down on a residential property. Clippings hauled out and the drive blown clean before the crew leaves.

projects.title: Mulch installation & bed definition
projects.alt: Front of a large home with freshly mulched beds, trimmed shrubs and a young ornamental tree
projects.description: Beds edged and re-cut, shrubs trimmed back, and fresh mulch laid around the foundation planting and specimen tree.

projects.title: Segmental block retaining wall
projects.alt: A curved segmental block retaining wall holding back a raised stone bed beside a house
projects.description: Curved block wall built on a compacted base with drainage behind it, holding back a re-graded bed on a sloping side yard.

projects.title: Commercial snow removal
projects.alt: A Bilski's plow truck clearing a snow-covered commercial parking lot
projects.description: Overnight plowing on a commercial parking lot so the site is open and safe to walk before customers arrive.
